name: Sweet Basil
description: Sweet basil is a fragrant culinary herb in the mint family. Highly sensitive to cold, it is prized across Mediterranean and Asian cooking.
uses: Core ingredient in classic Genovese pesto; pairs well with fresh tomatoes, garlic, mozzarella, and pasta dishes.
tips: Provide 6 to 8 hours of direct sun daily. Keep soil moist but well-drained, and water at the base to prevent leaf fungal spots.
